review_scope: design contracts only; implementation and production qualification remain required

operational_scenarios.flow: Lead or request to authorized work
operational_scenarios.gap: A contact list and job form do not cover inbound intake, duplicate requests, qualification/decline, follow-up, or controlled conversion to quote/job.
issue_slices: Lead/inquiry lifecycle with duplicate review and next action
Request-to-quote/job conversion preserving originating party/site/evidence and one conversion receipt
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Two concurrent conversions of one accepted request yield one resulting job/order link; declined or spam requests remain searchable only to authorized users, send no accidental confirmation, and can be reopened with reason. No recruiting Prospect required.

operational_scenarios.flow: Recurring customer agreement to visits and billing
operational_scenarios.owner: Quote/order agreement extension + workorder + scheduler + billing
operational_scenarios.gap: Recurring task generation alone omits the commercial agreement that authorizes a cleaning/maintenance contract, covered services, renewal/pause and what gets billed.
issue_slices: Versioned service agreements and renewal/pause/cancel lifecycle
Idempotent visit and billing occurrence materialization from the accepted agreement
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Changing a future agreement occurrence never rewrites accepted/completed historical visits or issued invoices; a DST boundary and mid-period pause produce an explicit reviewed schedule/amount change under a pinned policy, not guessed proration. JOB004 retries use one stable schedule-plus-logical-occurrence identity across amendments and moved-date aliases; agreement/schedule revisions are provenance, never a second uniqueness namespace. BILL006 separately owns stable commercial billing-period identity and corrections.

operational_scenarios.flow: Quote accepted to price change to cancellation
operational_scenarios.gap: Accepted quote conversion needs revision-bound commitments and downstream treatment of deposits, reservations and already performed work when scope changes or cancels.
issue_slices: Change-order amendment with approved revised scope/price/schedule
Cancellation settlement checklist for unused holds, committed purchases, consumed materials, earned work and deposits
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Accepting an expired or superseded quote fails before job/order creation; cancellation releases only unused reservations and leaves performed work/issued financial records immutable; affected outstanding obligations are visible until resolved.

operational_scenarios.gap: A crew assignment UI can schedule a worker whose leave, expired qualification, offboarding or revoked login makes the assignment invalid.
issue_slices: Job assignment eligibility and change invalidation adapter
Offboarding handover of future jobs, active custody and external access
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Assignment resolves current allowed qualification/availability facts without exposing HR medical/pay data; a later ineligibility event blocks dispatch or raises a named reassignment obligation. Offboarding revokes access and retains auditable completed work and unpaid obligations. Contractor status is not converted to employment.

operational_scenarios.flow: Time, materials and expenses to job cost and customer billing
operational_scenarios.owner: Workorder approved-entry adapters + billing + workforce time owners
operational_scenarios.gap: Job progress and a billing draft need actual approved time/material/subcontract/expense sources, partial allocations and correction rules. A full payroll rewrite is unnecessary.
issue_slices: Approved time and contractor source attribution with exact remaining billable quantity
Receipt-backed employee/business expense capture, approval, reimbursement obligation and accounting handoff
Cost versus price/chargeability projection and correction fan-out
operational_scenarios.acceptance: An approved 8-hour line allocated 5+3 cannot be billed a ninth hour or allocated again by a concurrent invoice. Corrections create reversal/rebill evidence without editing payroll snapshots. A reimbursement receipt cannot settle twice. Customer portal sees chargeable description/price but no employee pay rate or private receipt content.

operational_scenarios.flow: Job completion to complaint, rework or warranty
operational_scenarios.gap: Accept/close alone does not cover a customer disputing quantity/quality, returning for warranty service, or requesting rework after payment.
issue_slices: Completion acceptance and disputed/rework/warranty follow-up linked to original job
Commercial remedy approval linking replacement/rework, credit and refund without double compensation
operational_scenarios.acceptance: A follow-up is a new governed record linked to immutable original acceptance; staff can mark a no-charge warranty job explicitly; a complaint does not erase completion or automatically refund. Evidence share permissions stay compartmented.

operational_scenarios.flow: Purchase request to supplier bill and payment
operational_scenarios.owner: Purchasing + new narrow supplier-payable semantic owner + accounting connector
operational_scenarios.gap: PO and goods receipt are incomplete without vendor invoice intake, duplicate invoice detection, two/three-way matching, dispute, due amount and observed supplier payment.
issue_slices: Supplier invoice and credit intake with exact source/terms and duplicate review
Quantity/price/tolerance match against approved PO and accepted receipts
Payable ageing, approval and external/manual payment reconciliation
operational_scenarios.acceptance: A 10-unit PO with 6 received and 10 billed leaves 4 disputed/unmatched under explicit policy; partial delivery, overdelivery, duplicate supplier invoice number, changed supplier bank reference and correction are tested. Supplier payment authority is separate from receive/approve. No raw bank data or payroll settlement semantic reuse.

operational_scenarios.gap: A receipt must support damaged/short/over/substitute deliveries, pending inspection, multiple units of measure, serialized assets and partial acceptance before availability increases.
issue_slices: Receiving discrepancy and inspection resolution
UOM conversion/package precision and serial/lot identity rules
PO amendment/backorder/close remainder flow
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Only accepted quantity increases available stock; quarantined/damaged quantity remains visible but unreservable. Two receipt retries create one ledger movement. Duplicate serials or nonintegral serialized quantities fail before stock/asset mutation.

operational_scenarios.flow: Transfer and count to reconciled inventory
operational_scenarios.gap: Stock movement requires in-transit ownership, late arrivals, shrinkage/count conflict and valuation/source-policy boundaries to support multiple locations or vans.
issue_slices: Dispatch/receive transfer with partial arrival and loss investigation
Cycle-count sessions with movements during count and approved adjustments
Valuation basis/cost snapshot export with accountant-owned method configuration
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Shipping five units reduces source availability without making destination stock usable until receipt; receiving four records one discrepancy. A concurrent issue during count cannot be erased by setting a raw balance. Ledger reconstruction matches on-hand, reserved and in-transit separately.

operational_scenarios.flow: Customer or supplier return to stock and financial remedy
operational_scenarios.owner: Stock + purchasing + customer billing + supplier payable
operational_scenarios.gap: A negative stock movement is not a return process: authorization, inspection, restock/scrap/repair, replacement and refund/supplier credit must reconcile.
issue_slices: Return authorization and disposition
Return-to-credit/refund/replacement matching and closure
operational_scenarios.acceptance: A returned used item is not automatically available; return quantity is bounded by original fulfilled quantity less prior returns. Customer credit and provider refund remain separately observed states and cannot be duplicated. Supplier credit closes only the matched payable obligation.

operational_scenarios.flow: Equipment acquisition to maintenance and disposal
operational_scenarios.owner: Existing asset domain + workorder + scheduling + purchasing
operational_scenarios.gap: Custody/return alone omits periodic inspections, service due, calibration, out-of-service equipment, repair/replacement and evidenced disposal.
issue_slices: Maintenance/inspection plans and meter/date-triggered work
Out-of-service and reserved-asset conflict with substitution
Retire/dispose/loss recovery with inventory/accounting consequence references
operational_scenarios.acceptance: An overdue required inspection or unsafe condition blocks new dispatch without deleting current custody. Returning equipment records condition; a verified handoff does not imply safe-for-use. Retirement cannot silently close outstanding purchase/payable or worker-return obligations.

operational_scenarios.flow: Invoice to receipt, credit, dispute and reconciled cash
operational_scenarios.owner: Customer billing + payment adapter + accounting connector
operational_scenarios.gap: Invoice and paid checkbox omit deposits, partial payments, overpayments, unapplied receipts, fees, refunds, chargebacks and statement/collection follow-up.
issue_slices: Deposit and partial/unapplied receipt allocation
Provider failure/dispute/chargeback/refund reconciliation
Customer statements and policy-controlled overdue follow-up
operational_scenarios.acceptance: A late provider success after browser timeout reconciles one receipt; no blind recharge. Receipt allocations cannot exceed received amount or invoice remaining amount. A refund creates a distinct attributable record. Portal displays pending/failed/settled truth and never persists card details.

operational_scenarios.owner: Accounting integration + customer billing + supplier payable + stock
operational_scenarios.gap: Exporting invoices alone does not handle imports, chart/dimension mapping, closed periods, duplicate postings, conflicting provider edits, supplier bills, expense reimbursements and stock cost effects.
issue_slices: Cross-domain accounting export and bidirectional authority map
Period lock and correction posting policy
Reconciliation workbench with unposted/unmatched/duplicate/conflicting counts
operational_scenarios.acceptance: A closed-period correction produces a permitted later adjustment under approved policy or remains blocked; no silent backdating. Mapping version is frozen per posting, account/party remaps do not mutate historical entries, and provider account permissions are rechecked. Payroll paygl stays payroll-owned; borrow contracts only through justified ports.

operational_scenarios.owner: Portal participant extension + identity/access + documents + messaging
operational_scenarios.gap: An invitation needs expired/reissued/revoked/forwarded link behavior, customer-to-customer separation, multi-contact signatory role and external file/message privacy.
issue_slices: External participant invitation/verification/revocation lifecycle
Scoped customer/supplier communications and file sharing
Represented-party switch and action-specific signatory authorization
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Revoked or forwarded credentials grant zero data and zero actions; a customer who is also employee does not inherit HR access from party matching. Portal notes and attachments include explicit internal/customer/supplier visibility with safe defaults and denial before counts/search/download generation.

operational_scenarios.gap: Owners need actionable overdue work, workload, upcoming obligations, low stock, asset due, AR/AP ageing, invoiced versus collected amounts and job cost/margin with reliable freshness.
issue_slices: Role-bound SMB attention and operational KPI projections
Job-cost and margin explanation
AR/AP ageing and cash commitment forecast with assumption labels
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Unknown cost is not zero margin; stale input is labeled and blocks definitive claims. Totals reconcile to source snapshots and corrections, exports preserve allowed scope, and payroll/private vendor cost is absent from customer projections. Use existing Insights and Home attention rather than a second analytics engine.

operational_scenarios.flow: Spreadsheet onboarding to reversible launch and exit
operational_scenarios.owner: Existing DataOps + tenant lifecycle + configuration + export
operational_scenarios.gap: Contacts/items import alone misses opening stock balances, open AR/AP, outstanding jobs/POs, duplicate/foreign key matching and comprehensive usable exit artifacts.
issue_slices: Dependency-aware opening-state import and reconciliation
Company export/exit manifest across SMB records and attachments
Module disable/re-enable with outstanding obligations and historical access
operational_scenarios.acceptance: Dry-run writes zero business facts. A partially invalid batch cannot silently publish a misleading opening balance; committed row status and resumable repair are explicit. Export manifests include reference mappings, attachments, schemas and watermark/coverage; held records stay retained while tokens/devices are revoked.

operational_scenarios.flow: Offline field operation and device queue to restored system
operational_scenarios.owner: Device integration + workorder + stock + platform recovery
operational_scenarios.gap: Offline capture and database restore can replay already printed labels, submitted payments, consumed inventory or accepted customer work unless epochs/fences cross every queued command.
issue_slices: Cross-module offline command reconciliation and visible conflicts
Tenant restore/migration epoch fencing of device, webhook and payment queues
Local connector replacement/update/reinstall with durable pending-command recovery
operational_scenarios.acceptance: A restored older snapshot cannot automatically re-execute an acknowledged external effect. Unknown device outcome remains uncertain; offline scans do not promise globally reserved stock. The UI shows queued locally, received, rejected/conflict and committed distinctly, including operator/device attribution.

operational_scenarios.flow: Support and correction across connected business modules
operational_scenarios.owner: Existing repair/operations/human-work owners + domain correction ports
operational_scenarios.gap: Each module's retry button is inadequate when the business process partially succeeded across job, stock, invoice and provider. Users need one clear blocker and a bounded repair path without re-running the whole workflow.
issue_slices: Connected-operation timeline and business-aware repair proposals
End-to-end adverse scenario conformance for each complete operational loop
operational_scenarios.acceptance: A stock success plus invoice failure leaves the stock fact intact, offers the exact failed next action, and cannot charge or consume twice. A repair author cannot silently self-approve where policy separates roles. Reconciliation exposes component outcomes and the business completion condition.

operational_coverage.note: Team access/invitation distinguishes workers and contractors and preserves restricted HR fields. Assignment eligibility/offboarding dispatch obligations remain scheduling/job owner issues.
Internal team role setup and shared purpose-bound operational messaging only; external participant scopes/invitation and party switch remain SMB-PORTAL owner.
Home/My Work/Insights source projections, role-filtered drilldown, amount/forecast/freshness contracts. Source job-margin/AR/AP/stock calculations remain domain-authoritative.

Resumable setup, data staging/commit, operating defaults, dependency-aware opening obligations, explicit source cutover, full export and module disable/re-enable/exit. Existing lifecycle/API work is a prerequisite rather than recreated.

Existing recovery epoch authority fences all restored device/payment/webhook command envelopes; local capture is provisional, physical results remain uncertain after ambiguous send; connector replacement/update preserves evidence.

Existing outcome/repair/workflow owners expose component results and exact safe next action. Per-domain operational-loop adverse scenarios remain required in domain issue acceptance as well as shared conformance.
Lead qualification/decline/duplicate/reopen and immutable one-conversion receipt; Sales supplies quote/order owner.

Sales SMB-SALE-007 owns agreement lifecycle/terms; JOB004 job occurrences with persistent logical identity; appointment owns booked capacity; BILL006 invoice periods. Integrated gate tests amendment/pause/DST.
Operational scope/acceptance/cancel and resources/cost evidence; Sales006 and BILL008/009 own commercial amendments/remedies.
Current qualifications/leave/project access; workforce-derived offboarding handover preserves independent business representation. Asset owner retains custody.

Time/Expense/Stock owners approve and bound cost-source allocation; JOB007 attributes immutable owner receipts to work; BILL002 separately owns source-to-invoice consumption/remaining capacity (8h=>5+3 rejects ninth), BILL010/016 expense/reimbursement. No competing job-side invoice balance.
Immutable completion/acceptance plus complaint/warranty/rework, no-charge decision and per-remedy dedupe; Billing credits/refunds separate.
Supplier portal is bounded exposure of BUY003/004/007 and BILL012/013; purchasing/payable owners own matching/payment, not portal.
Service complaint/remedy intake links to stock-return and billing remedy owners; no stock/restock/refund truth in cases.
Scheduling consumes current asset readiness and temporal booking; asset lifecycle/inspection/disposal remains inventory_resources cluster.
Invoice viewing/hosted-payment launch/status via BILL003/007/015; no card data or payment-return trust.
Complete independent external representation lifecycle, signatory checks, context isolation and explicit shared content. Existing cross-company project grants remain separate.
Authorized operations queues/promise metrics and cost source freshness; parent/commercial reporting owns margin/AR/AP.
DataOps relationship target with component PARTIAL and recovery; SETUP004/005 pipeline, SETUP009 opening obligations and SETUP010 full export/exit own integrated flow.
Allowlisted encrypted offline drafts and reminder restore-epoch fencing; CORE002/006 and Device own cross-module stale queue/external effect recovery.
Component receipts, unknown outcomes, failed-step retry and no duplicate remedy; root CORE integrated repair timeline/adverse scenario suite completes cross-owner orchestration.
Job cancellation releases only unconsumed stock and future bookings; received goods/issued equipment/supplier commitments persist.
Existing offboarding custody obligations retained; worker eligibility/dispatch policy remains JOB/SCHED.
Inventory and purchase accepted receipts feed material/job-cost source events; billing/time/expense attribution owned by other clusters.
SupplierBillEvidence intake/duplicate review and match here; SMB-BILL-012/013 owns payable/credits/AP and observed payments; SMB-ACCT-004 financial export.
Explicit UOM, lots, serials, accepted/quarantined/rejected, substitute amendment and backorder close.
Transfer transit/count conflict/journal reconciliation here; accounting owner determines valuation method/cost effect.
Physical return inspection/restock/quarantine/scrap/replacement and original-receipt bounds; BILL008/009 customer credit/refund and BILL012 supplier credit.
Enhance canonical asset owner for acquisition, maintenance/inspection, out-of-service, custody, disposal and downstream obligations.
Export source acquisition/quantity snapshots and match receipts; monetary valuation/period correction policy remains ACCT.
Stock shortage, transfer discrepancy, expiry, equipment due and purchasing commitment attention feed existing Home/Insights; financial margin/AP elsewhere.

Shared SETUP/DataOps owns staging/launch/exit; STOCK012 and ASSET002 define opening stock/equipment domain import; BUY008 imports open/partially received purchasing and evidence without reposting pre-cutover goods or resending supplier effects.
Offline observations and durable stock/supplier-effect reconciliation; restore epoch and connector queues owned CORE/DEVICE.
Partial outcome receipts preserve completed component facts; shared repair timeline delegated CORE, domain correction ports here.
Consumes CRM inquiry/conversion source; quote/order version and one fulfillment request retain originating identity. CRM/job own intake/qualification.
Agreement lifecycle and billing occurrences; JOB004/SCHED own visit occurrence scheduling and DST.
Revision-bound acceptance/change/cancel; linked job/stock/purchasing impact obligations and credit/deposit disposition.
Consumes JOB007/FTIME005/WTIME011 approved sources; claim conservation, expense distinction, cost/margin and payable handoff.
JOB008 owns complaint/rework/warranty case. Commercial remedy requires independent credit/refund eligibility and links case/evidence; complaint is not automatic compensation.

BUY009 owns intake/duplicates and approved non-PO path; BUY007 owns PO matching. Narrow payable owner owns obligations/credits, due balances and observed payment; existing settlement/connector owns effect.
STOCK011 supplies qualified cost-effect evidence with approved acquisition/external valuation basis; accounting maps it and reports provenance without choosing/calculating a valuation method.
STOCK010/BUY005 own return authorization/disposition; separate financial credit/refund/payable adjustment and matching closure.
Deposit/partial/unapplied, hosted payment ambiguity, fees/net vs gross, chargebacks, credits/refunds/disputes and reminders.
Cross-domain accounting mappings/authority and source schemas; period locks, adjustments and reconciliation while PAYGL remains payroll-owned.
Consumes portal participant scope; exact represented-party/signatory proof and hosted customer payment with no HR/private financial data disclosure.
AR/AP aging, explicit cost/margin basis and cash commitment assumptions in existing reporting/Home scope.
SETUP owns wizard/exit orchestration; these provide typed opening AR/AP/order schema, reconciliation and usable commercial exports.
Commercial restore epoch fencing and financial queues; device/job offline capture remains respective owners.
Connected partial success and bounded financial repair conformance via existing workbench; CORE owns global timeline.

design.summary: Extend the current configuration/capability/page, DataOps, trust and integration owners to add optional business modules, guided setup and device connectivity. Domain modules own business semantics; edge adapters are transport and observation sources. Existing HR/workflow and Phase 1 limits remain authoritative until later-phase gated admission.

subsystems.name: Platform composition and API adoption

existing_evidence.what_exists: Existing config owns behavior selection and activation, not domain effects.
existing_evidence.limitation: Add bounded module manifest references to signed immutable bundles and dependency resolution.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Avoid a new feature flag/configuration database.
existing_evidence.limitation: Reuse validation, signature, approval and activation lifecycle.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Existing governed bundle history is the authority.
existing_evidence.limitation: Persist module activation through existing registry stores.

existing_evidence.what_exists: A module cannot acquire authority from navigation visibility.
existing_evidence.limitation: Register exact capability versions through application composition.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Avoid an alternate router or UI stack.
existing_evidence.limitation: Bind module pages and feature audiences to existing immutable registry.

subsystems.design: Seven bounded slices cover module/intent registration, API adoption, unified discovery, operational reporting, messaging/consent, recovery fences and targeted cross-domain repair. No new engine, auth model or frontend stack.
subsystems.ui_ux: Configuration center module review; existing Home/My Work/search and object links; optional role-relevant hubs.
risks: Existing generic API/page permission backlog must land first.
Disabled modules need drain/history behavior and cannot simply hide navigation.

subsystems.name: Guided setup

existing_evidence.what_exists: Authenticated immutable CSV staging into durable DataOps store.
existing_evidence.limitation: Business-target profiles and guided SMB setup not established.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Typed onboarding run conventions for incumbent extraction.
existing_evidence.limitation: This is not a general business setup authority and currently stores coordinator state in memory.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Immutable bundles and externally verified activation approval.
existing_evidence.limitation: Starter profiles need admitted dependencies and explicit upgrade diffs.

subsystems.design: Twelve bounded slices cover resumable setup, guided UI, templates, staging, commit, team access, first-outcome proof, business operating defaults, opening-state cutover, portable export, module suspension/re-enable and full company closure.
subsystems.ui_ux: One plain-language guided task under Configuration center, with optional modules and site/role scope; data errors before effects.
risks: Do not equate contacts, employees and accounts.
Imported stock opening balance must use stock movements.
Profile cannot claim ready if referenced workflow is absent.

subsystems.name: Device connectivity
subsystems.owner: connectivity/trust/application/productui; proposed constrained edge host adapter

existing_evidence.what_exists: Read-only adapter Describe/Probe/ReadSnapshot/ObserveChanges interface.
existing_evidence.limitation: Writes must use existing governed effect seams, not widen observation-only interface.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Ordering, fencing, normalized observations and ambiguous/repair states.
existing_evidence.limitation: Physical drivers, local durable spool and hardware evidence are new deltas.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Fenced, credentialed connector dispatch funnel.
existing_evidence.limitation: Local connector must connect outward without server-worker privilege.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Closed server-role vocabulary and bounded verified identities.
existing_evidence.limitation: A separately constrained edge role and pairing/key proof are required.

subsystems.design: Twelve slices cover binding, bridge, offline queue, scanner, serial/USB sensor, LAN appliance, printing, optional browser APIs, health, updates, conformance and qualified support.
subsystems.ui_ux: Existing integration hub and domain contextual capture controls; truthfully distinguish captured/submitted/accepted/observed/uncertain; manual/keyboard alternatives.
risks: No exactly-once physical effect promise.
Browser/driver/model compatibility must be measured.
Offline input is pending observation, not authority to consume stock.
Revocation bounds and queue evidence survival require hardware/process failure tests.

external_sources.claim: WebUSB requires secure context and an explicit user gesture for chooser; interface/vendor compatibility and permissions matter.
Web Serial exposes selected serial devices; chooser/permission and device lifecycle are explicit.
Browser local-network permission requirements exist; do not promise unrestricted browser access to LAN devices.
WebUSB specification remains the reference for interface and permission semantics; support is qualified by actual matrix.

operational_coverage.note: Team access/invitation distinguishes workers and contractors and preserves restricted HR fields. Assignment eligibility/offboarding dispatch obligations remain scheduling/job owner issues.
Internal team role setup and shared purpose-bound operational messaging only; external participant scopes/invitation and party switch remain SMB-PORTAL owner.
Home/My Work/Insights source projections, role-filtered drilldown, amount/forecast/freshness contracts. Source job-margin/AR/AP/stock calculations remain domain-authoritative.

Resumable setup, data staging/commit, operating defaults, dependency-aware opening obligations, explicit source cutover, full export and module disable/re-enable/exit. Existing lifecycle/API work is a prerequisite rather than recreated.

Existing recovery epoch authority fences all restored device/payment/webhook command envelopes; local capture is provisional, physical results remain uncertain after ambiguous send; connector replacement/update preserves evidence.

Existing outcome/repair/workflow owners expose component results and exact safe next action. Per-domain operational-loop adverse scenarios remain required in domain issue acceptance as well as shared conformance.

implementation_prerequisite_review.scope: Three prerequisite additions only; previous full design review preserved. Current defects independently accepted in implementation-review/implementation-gap-review.json.

changes.reason: Signed DataOps simulation with multiple conflict entries self-invalidates because conflict evidence and references diverge in ordering; canonical ordering fix is required before SMB import preview/adoption.
DataOps corrective payload loses absent-versus-present-empty baseline state; correction-presence fix is required before SMB partial import recovery and corrective intents.
Denied connector status projection retains private evidence references; disclosure fix is required before device health/diagnostics status exposure.

import_service_boundary_review.scope: Narrow exact service ownership binding for SETUP004/005. Preserve existing DataOpsService P1A import-staging ceiling; propose separate later ImportService under the existing owner. No dependency changes.
import_service_boundary_review.cross_lane_requirement: CRM007 must bind the later ImportService methods under existing DataOps owner; never add committing target methods to P1A DataOpsService.

design.summary: Promote small-business relationships/service-work/scheduling/portal capabilities by extending verified existing semantic owners, with explicit proposed deltas and current serving limitations. Existing HR/ChangeOps Phase1 remains gated; implementation is future work, not claimed shipped. All 29 issue/TODO contracts receive adversarial per-ID review.

subsystems.name: Business relationships
subsystems.owner: Existing Organization and Relationship domain, Contact, Location and Identity Resolution; new typed business-party registry as owned extension

existing_evidence.what_exists: Manager relationship/change/intent semantics under Organization owner
existing_evidence.limitation: No commercial business-party registry; separate proposed records must not feed supervisory hierarchy.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Read-only authorized internal organization graph
existing_evidence.limitation: Customer/supplier parties are not internal org units or AuthZ parents.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Normalized verified purpose-scoped endpoints
existing_evidence.limitation: Does not own business affiliation/portal grants.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Canonical Address and effective-dated work locations/sites
existing_evidence.limitation: Service-location purpose and commercial-party association need extension.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Recruiting prospects/consent/talent CRM
existing_evidence.limitation: Explicitly not customer/supplier CRM; preserve unchanged.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Governed identity links/do-not-merge primitives
existing_evidence.limitation: Business-party consumer manifests/fences are new adapters.

subsystems.design: Typed party and independent effective commercial roles, contact affiliations, service locations, enquiry conversion, controlled duplicate repair and DataOps target; use existing semantic owners, no new generic CRM engine. New businessrelationshipstore is proposed because orggraph/orgfacts are existing read projections, not authoritative business-party stores.
subsystems.ui_ux: Relationships accessible hub pinned from Home/search, contextual list/detail and customer job/quote pickers; same productui shell/Go stack. Exact routes/states/fields are per issue.
risks: Keep internal workforce/person fields separate from business relationships.
Cross-store composites need PARTIAL and repair receipts.
No automatic email-based merge or authority.

subsystems.name: Service and job management
subsystems.owner: Existing Work Order/workorderservice/workorderstore with Human Work/Projects/Forms/Documents

existing_evidence.what_exists: Phase transitions, requests, assignment, progress/time/spend and immutable journal
existing_evidence.limitation: Project/template mandatory; customer/service metadata, lifecycle exposures and admission binding need extension.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Trusted principal/project scope, current eligibility, CAS/idempotency orchestration
existing_evidence.limitation: No customer portal bypass permitted; need safe separate projections.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Separate credential/storage owner with RLS/journal/outbox/receipts
existing_evidence.limitation: No distributed transaction with parties/schedules/stock/billing.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Implementation checkpoint records backend present, live signed execution binding pending
existing_evidence.limitation: Must prove positive admitted runtime transition, not just RPC success.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Pricing/source draft calculation
existing_evidence.limitation: Issued customer invoices and billable consumption remain Billing owner.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Employee request adapter and shared WorkItem path
existing_evidence.limitation: Customer service type/visibility needs explicit distinct semantics; confidential HR never reused by relabeling.

subsystems.design: Extend one workorder subject with service offering/intake, customer/site refs, mobile checklist/evidence, recurring agreements->job occurrences, scope acceptance/cancellation, operational queues, approved source adapters and corrective service cases. Projects coordinate; workflow gates execution; each adjacent domain retains truth.
subsystems.ui_ux: My Work and project Jobs tab expose canonical service job; mobile field execution is distinct from office triage but same capabilities. Service templates use current Admin configuration.
risks: Current workorder registration candidate is not production readiness.
Accepted history must survive cancellation/rework.
Recurrence logical identities and cross-store conversion/remedy receipts are essential.

subsystems.name: Scheduling and dispatch

existing_evidence.what_exists: Purpose/location/capacity/participant/resource requirement semantics
existing_evidence.limitation: Add SERVICE_VISIT; preserve hiring/training types.

existing_evidence.what_exists: Shared reservation primitives consumed by memory ReservationLedger
existing_evidence.limitation: Durable multi-process overlapping capacity admission still needs explicit integration.

existing_evidence.what_exists: PostgreSQL requirement/resource/availability/device/published schedule state

existing_evidence.what_exists: Shift publication/reassignment/current schedule reader

existing_evidence.what_exists: Existing Time schedule surface

subsystems.design: One durable appointment occupancy authority within existing workforce availability, role/resource requirements and source revisions; dispatch, booking, changes, provider sync, eligibility handover and explicit operational calendars. Sales owns agreement terms; JOB owns generated work; Scheduling owns reserved visit capacity.
subsystems.ui_ux: Reuse /workspace/app/time/schedule, list/agenda mobile and equivalent keyboard scheduling; constrained portal booking shows requested/held/confirmed separately.
risks: Different overlapping timestamp ranges must conflict, not merely exact key duplicates.
Request-only booking requires job/readiness before confirmation.
Provider/reminder outcomes cannot be exactly-once/recall promises.

subsystems.name: External customer and supplier portals
subsystems.owner: Existing Authentication/Trust/RoleAccess, Organization representation grants, Chat/Documents and owning domain projections

existing_evidence.what_exists: Governed workforce subject-link identity contract
existing_evidence.limitation: Add explicit non-workforce target version; do not fabricate workforce identity.

existing_evidence.what_exists: External guest bounded role/expiration/revocation and bilateral project admission

behavior: Declare exactly one owner for party, job, schedule, quote/order, invoice, stock, asset and purchasing state; existing domains are extended where actual source overlaps.

Compile rejects cycles, undeclared capabilities, duplicate semantic ownership and pages with no permission mapping. A domain module cannot grant itself roles or use workflow tables as its state store.

Activation includes pinned schema/migration readiness. Suspension blocks new domain starts, drains or explicitly quarantines pending effects, preserves authorized history/corrections and exposes the reason; retirement cannot drop referenced records.

Concurrent module activation uses revision compare-and-swap; dependency changes invalidate stale previews. Adoption requires release authority for write classes and preserves P1A read-only conformance.

For every new business command publish exact versioned semantic IntentDefinition, schema/capability bindings, effect/repair model and accepted scope in existing registries; extend any closed domain/role/feature vocabulary additively with conformance tests. BI.* labels alone never satisfy executable registration. Declared ordinary business role grants and separately scoped edge role cannot inherit server-worker authority.

Review transport manifest/classification/phase entries for every additive method/projection. Existing WorkOrderService currently pins PHASE_1 and CONFIDENTIAL_HR: preserve old compatibility while declaring actual later-phase SMB admission and field classifications explicitly. HTTP resource aliases are generated by existing endpoint owner (INTAPI-007/008), never parallel hand-written routes.

Use existing productui page modules, GWC/Go SSR and Go/WASM, semantic tokens and floorplans; reuse shell, Home/My Work, admin hubs, search and pins. No permanent global nav entry per subsystem. Server-authorized data and actions remain authoritative; loading is bounded, retry explicit, denied and stale/offline states truthful.
acceptance: Two modules with a dependency cycle fail publication with deterministic paths; an unknown capability or duplicate owner also fails before activation.

Suspend a module between request preparation and dispatch prevents its new write, while authorized existing record read and observed-result recovery still work.
Deep link, search result, action discovery and direct RPC agree on availability; disabled navigation alone never substitutes for server checks.

A module with only BI.* tags but missing executable IntentDefinition/model binding fails admission. New closed vocabulary values resolve exactly and old values preserve behavior; unsupported identities fail closed.

Manifest test proves additive commercial methods cannot inherit PHASE_1 or blanket HR classification accidentally; existing endpoints retain reviewed compatibility and private field rules. Generated RPC/HTTP parity and release gate tests reject an undeclared alias or write class.
test_plan: PRIMARY: exercise the stated state transitions, boundary values and refusal codes, with independent output/state assertions.
INTEGRATION: real PostgreSQL via internal/data/pgtest and served generated RPC/HTTP edge; prove authorized write/read round trips and reconnect/restart persistence for this slice.
SECURITY: two tenants and allowed/denied roles, expired/revoked actors, forged resource refs and cross-scope requests; assert zero unauthorized records/effects and non-revealing errors.
FAULT/RECOVERY: inject the slice-specific interruption described in acceptance, restart runtime/store and assert convergence without duplicate logical work or false success.

BROWSER: drive the consuming route and actual action against a served runtime; inspect desktop/mobile/theme/locale/focus/error/denied states and retain screenshots. API-only work proves its consuming page response, not an invented standalone UI.

Run targeted package tests, component/uxqual then real runtime E2E and required repository gates; race scenarios run in CI where Windows arm64 lacks race support. Test names must contain assertions and cannot alias another todo.

issues.api_contract:
Canonical protocol: Protobuf and generated EndpointDefinition; proposed messages below are additions, never replacements for existing messages. IDs/refs are opaque UTF-8 strings validated against typed registered entity kinds and trusted scope; expected revisions are uint64>0 unless explicitly create-absent; keys are bounded nonempty strings under CORE002. Display name is display_name everywhere. Dates use LocalDate, instants google.protobuf.Timestamp, zones IANA strings, quantities/decimals/money existing common value messages (never floats). Entity-ref arrays and enums follow the data_contract closed vocabulary; source_versions is a bounded list of {source_ref,revision,digest}; field masks select authorized declared fields only. RoleInterval={role,effective_from,effective_to?,owner_ref?}; TypedAnswer={field_id,schema_version,oneof typed primitive/entity/document ref}; all other named record shapes are explicitly defined by this issue data_contract/owning domain. Unknown fields/enum values reject under existing strict wire policy. Principal/tenant/roles are authenticated context; requested scope/representation are selectors checked by server, never authority.
Each proposed query states its exact required/optional fields and returned projection; it has no business mutations. Each proposed command states its own revision owner and output; no blanket WriteEnvelope is added. Mutation success may be committed receipt or typed pending Operation for cross-owner work; response does not mean provider success. Replayed key returns same result; changed payload conflicts. List optional page_size is 1..100 and cursor is signed/bound principal+tenant+company/representation+filters+watermark+expiry. Existing workorder RPC-style HTTP aliases remain, additive /v1 routes below are generated. New SMB endpoint disposition is PHASE_3/4 with correct field classification, never inherited PHASE_1/CONFIDENTIAL_HR.
ErrorDetail mapping: malformed400, unauthenticated401, disclosed-denied403, hidden/absent404, idempotency/state-conflict409, stale revision/precondition412, quota429, unavailable503, deadline504; typed pending202 plus operation resource. Include safe field violations/retry class/correlation and current revision only when authorized. Required security/refusal audit is retained; zero business-success effects on refusal.

Required strings are nonempty and bounded by existing field policy; typed user descriptions/evidence obey the concrete limits in UI/behavior. behavior: Resolve company scope from trusted authority and declared source authority, not caller roles. Same party may be both customer and supplier; end one role without erasing the other.

Archive blocks new business use but preserves open commitments and historical snapshots; attempts with open jobs/orders return dependency references permitted to the actor, and offer end-role-at-date policy.
Business relationship edges are explicitly non-inheriting for internal supervisory authorization. External-mastered fields reject local writes and link to existing reconciliation.
Proof includes schema/storage-disposition/RLS and served create/read/role/end/archive integration; it is not a documentation-only contract.

All writes run through the registered application capability with trusted tenant/actor and current organization/resource/field authority, expected revision, canonical digest and idempotency key. Equal retries replay the original receipt, changed payload rejects; failed validation/auth/revision conflict writes zero domain/business-success rows, business-success journal/outbox entries and provider requests; preserve required sanitized security/refusal audit through its current owner. Reads, search, counts, exports and event payloads enforce the same current scope. Persist domain mutation, append-only journal and outbox in the owning store transaction with tenant RLS and storage-disposition entries.

RestoreParty restores archived record discovery only after current authority/source validation; ended/expired roles remain ended. AddRole with a new effective interval is separately required before new customer/supplier operations. Open commitments can prevent archive but never erase history.

Ending CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER role blocks new commitments at its effective time but preserves separate purpose-scoped authority to settle, correct, return or service already-existing obligations under their original contract. Historical job/order/invoice owner checks current actor/resource permission and the recorded obligation authority; it must not require a newly active commercial role merely to discharge or correct that obligation. Restore does not reactivate new-business role authority.

behavior: DRAFT edits create revisions; any material revision invalidates approval and prior acceptance links. ACCEPTED references the exact approved/sent content and signer/delegate authority; unknown acceptance never confirms an order.
Currency, legal entity and customer cannot change after acceptance. A cancelled or expired quote cannot later accept; acceptance/expiry contention commits exactly one outcome.
Existing workorderbilling.Issued means a draft lifecycle event, not an AR invoice or payment. Preserve that legacy meaning and name new projections unambiguously.

Commands authorize tenant, legal entity, resource, purpose and field access before reads that disclose data or any mutation/effect. Current authority and module enablement are rechecked at commit; guessed IDs return the standard neutral denied/not-found response.

Use SMB-CORE-002 versioned API, expected revision and tenant-scoped idempotency semantics: same canonical request returns its original receipt; a reused key with changed payload is a conflict; an observed timeout never becomes an invented success. Server validates every supplied reference and amount.

Persist domain transition, audit lineage and effect intent atomically through existing transaction/outbox boundaries; cross-store writes use owner commands and resumable orchestration, never direct foreign-table edits. New tenant tables require FORCE RLS and storage-disposition registration; immutable revisions/events require forbid_mutation.

Security refusal may append the existing authorized denial/security telemetry receipt; prohibited side effects mean no domain money/state mutation, outbox business intent or provider call. Tests assert both allowed denial observability and absent unauthorized effects rather than demanding zero audit records.
ui_ux: API contract is consumed by proposed /workspace/app/sales/quotes/{id} and customer Commercial tab. Render through existing productui, GoWebComponents SSR plus Go/WASM, governed page/widget definitions, shell and semantic theme tokens. Use contextual customer/job links, role hubs, pins and My Work; do not add a permanent global navigation destination for this story.

Use labeled controls, semantic headings/tables, keyboard-operable actions, error summary linked to fields, visible focus, and return focus to the invoking control after dialogs.

Bound loading with a retry action and retained filter/draft state. Distinguish no records, no matches, dependency unavailable, denied, offline, stale/conflict, pending observation and completed states. Disable money-changing submission offline with a clear explanation; never queue invisible financial effects or silently overwrite a newer revision. After success announce the durable record/status and retain a direct detail link.

issues.data_contract: ItemRevision: company,item_id,SKU,kind CONSUMABLE|SERIALIZED_EQUIPMENT,base_unit,scale,tracking NONE|LOT|SERIAL,active,revision. Movement: movement_id,kind RECEIVE|ISSUE|ADJUST|TRANSFER|RETURN|REVERSAL,positive base_quantity,source/destination stock buckets,recorded_at,effective_at,item/unit revision,reason,source_ref,original_movement_ref,actor,operation_id. Balances derive only from committed movements; raw free = usable_on_hand - active allocations; available-to-promise=max(0,raw free), shortage=max(0,-raw free). Routine issue cannot create shortage; approved count/loss records truthful physical stock and explicitly blocks affected reservations. Separate quarantine/in_transit/lost/disposed buckets. Serialized stock uses integer quantities and asset refs; one serial has one physical bucket. Initial release refuses negative usable balances. Every write authenticates human/app/device origin and authorizes tenant, company, site and record before effects; revalidate on commit. Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL RLS, storage-disposition registration, append-only fact triggers, immutable request digest and unique tenant+operation key; exact duplicate returns durable result, changed payload conflicts. Business update and outbox/audit receipt commit together; failure before commit changes nothing and failure after commit is resolved by operation lookup, never blind replay. Cross-domain effects call typed application capabilities and reconcile partial outcomes. Commands and offline/import batches bind the active tenant recovery epoch from SMB-CORE-002; restored or migrated stale epochs are refused for revalidation, not automatically replayed against the older state. Canonical physical serial key is (company_id, serial_namespace_id, normalized_serial) owned by existing asset domain; serial namespace declares immutable normalization policy (default exact Unicode NFC with surrounding whitespace removed, case and leading zeros preserved). issues.data_contract: Delivery receipt snapshots PO line revision,supplier document,actual quantity+unit,accepted/quarantined/rejected quantities,lot/serial,condition,evidence and remaining backorder. Each line maps to stock movement/asset IDs or accepted service evidence. Supplier slip number supports duplicate warning but operation key remains authoritative. Every write authenticates human/app/device origin and authorizes tenant, company, site and record before effects; revalidate on commit. Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL RLS, storage-disposition registration, append-only fact triggers, immutable request digest and unique tenant+operation key; exact duplicate returns durable result, changed payload conflicts. Business update and outbox/audit receipt commit together; failure before commit changes nothing and failure after commit is resolved by operation lookup, never blind replay. Cross-domain effects call typed application capabilities and reconcile partial outcomes. Commands and offline/import batches bind the active tenant recovery epoch from SMB-CORE-002; restored or migrated stale epochs are refused for revalidation, not automatically replayed against the older state. Per PO line ordered commitment O, cumulative physically arrived P, accepted delivery A, pending inspection Q, rejected at inspection R, supplier-return-dispatched D and not-yet-arrived N are distinct. Receipt inspection classification conserves P=A+Q+R; these are historical delivery totals, not current onsite balance. Current physical custody/availability is queried from stock journal and includes all issues/transfers/returns/disposals; D is a separately linked outbound fact and is not subtracted from P or A. N=max(0,O-P-cancelled_unreceived). Unfulfilled acceptance obligation=max(0,O-A-closed_unaccepted); pending Q may satisfy it later. Rejected R or returned accepted units create explicit replacement/credit/cancel remedy; do not count the same quantity simultaneously in two demand sources. Subsequent usage/return does not rewrite original A.
issues.api_contract: StartPOReceipt/CaptureReceipt/InspectReceipt/PostPOReceipt/CloseBackorder/ProposeSubstitution. Tolerance policy version governs overreceipt and price discrepancy; unsupported substitute requires approved PO amendment before availability credit. RecordSupplierShipmentNotice(exact PO revision,represented supplier,notice_id,dispatch estimate,carrier/reference optional,line quantities,evidence) stores supplier observation only; it does not invoke PostPOReceipt or any stock/asset command.
behavior: For O10,P8,A6,Q2,R0: physically arrived8,accepted6,pending2,not arrived2. Show commercial acceptance outstanding4 with pending-inspection2 included, not an additional order4. Closing remainder requires reason and supplier commitment resolution; neither overdue due date nor zero remaining client field auto-closes.

Rejected goods physically present enter quarantine/rejected bucket with return/disposal obligation; a refusal before unloading is external supplier-retained evidence and creates no local stock. SERVICE/NONSTOCK receipt is explicit service/delivery acceptance evidence under procurement, not a stock movement; do not create dummy item/bin/lot or require Inventory enabled. issues.title: Move stock between sites with explicit dispatch, transit and receipt
issues.why: Physical transfers take time and may arrive partially or damaged; a one-step location edit loses that truth.
issues.new_code: Proposed inventory Transfer aggregate, dispatched/received movement correlation and transfer workbench.
issues.data_contract: Transfer lines have source/destination,requested,dispatched,received,damaged,unaccounted,unit snapshot and serial/lot refs; lifecycle DRAFT|READY|DISPATCHED|PARTIALLY_RECEIVED|RECEIVED|DISCREPANCY|CANCELLED. Transit stock is owned by company but not available at either site; links capture source allocation and shipment evidence. Every write authenticates human/app/device origin and authorizes tenant, company, site and record before effects; revalidate on commit. Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL RLS, storage-disposition registration, append-only fact triggers, immutable request digest and unique tenant+operation key; exact duplicate returns durable result, changed payload conflicts. Business update and outbox/audit receipt commit together; failure before commit changes nothing and failure after commit is resolved by operation lookup, never blind replay. Cross-domain effects call typed application capabilities and reconcile partial outcomes. Commands and offline/import batches bind the active tenant recovery epoch from SMB-CORE-002; restored or migrated stale epochs are refused for revalidation, not automatically replayed against the older state. Each transfer line snapshots source quality state/bucket and destination eligibility policy. A transit line carries preserved quality and lot/serial identity; transit is physical location state, not approval of quality. Quarantine-purpose location does not manufacture a second quality quantity.
issues.api_contract: Create/Approve/DispatchTransfer/ReceiveTransfer/ResolveTransferDiscrepancy/CancelTransfer. Each dispatch/receipt is a separately idempotent receipt with expected revision; overreceipt or source/destination mismatch refused.
behavior: Dispatch atomically decreases the declared source physical/quality bucket and increases transit preserving quality; receipt decreases transit and credits destination with the same or stricter quality state. Usable goods may arrive damaged and enter quarantine; quarantined goods cannot become usable on transfer without separately authorized inspection release. Total physical quantity is conserved until explicit owner-approved loss/disposal.
Cancel draft releases hold; after dispatch use return transfer or discrepancy resolution, never teleport quantity back.
Partial receipts cannot exceed undelivered amount. Different site actors need respective dispatch/receive rights; a source user cannot assert remote receipt without destination permission.

Serialized equipment ISSUE/RETURN/TRANSFER/LOSS/ADJUST commands require asset-owner capability result binding exact asset/custody/serviceability revision and movement operation. Generic stock commands cannot directly alter equipment availability/custody; acquisition is Pending asset registration, and a reconciliation failure remains unavailable rather than bypassing asset policy.

Quarantine transfers require explicit move-quarantined permission and a physical-quantity hold distinct from material demand availability; they cannot be refused merely because usable quantity0 or borrow a consumable allocation that pretends quarantine is fulfillable. Use existing reservation identity/fence with inventory-owned physical bucket capacity, separate purpose TRANSFER_CUSTODY; no reservation enables issue to a job.
ui_ux: Proposed /workspace/app/inventory/transfers with Needs dispatch/In transit/Needs review filters; detail header shows From → To and progress quantities.
Dispatch checklist shows item, quantity, lot/serial and recipient; Receive form defaults blank actual received quantity rather than remaining, includes Condition good/damaged and discrepancy reason.

Missing units remain In transit / investigation until explicit resolution. Timeline distinguishes dispatched, acknowledged and received. Mobile receipt cards prioritize scan/manual item, remaining and quantity; completion names destination and receipt.

Use existing internal/humanwork/productui and GoWebComponents/Go SSR+WASM, shell, list-detail, validation summary and semantic tokens. Entry through role-relevant Home pins, My Work and authorized search; no new permanent global navigation. Browser Back/Forward preserves filters; company switch clears drafts from view and requires explicit resume in original company. Every surface: 1280x720, 390 and 320 widths; light/dark; en-US/de-DE/ar RTL; localized exact numbers but canonical API decimal strings; labels and field-associated errors; keyboard focus to error summary/first invalid field and back to invoking control on cancel. Loading is bounded with retry, empty states name a next permitted action, errors preserve draft, denied/missing references disclose no protected details, offline is clearly uncommitted, conflicts show authoritative version and require review, completion shows durable operation receipt and linked outcome. Never infer success from toast, scan beep, websocket, HTTP acceptance or stale projection.

Honor reduced-motion preference; no required animation or audio to understand outcome. Capture actual-runtime screenshots at desktop and390/320 widths for initial, post-interaction and failure states and inspect clipping, contrast, focus, overflow and localized content before acceptance; attach evidence to issue.
acceptance: Dispatch 10 then receive 7 good +1 damaged leaves 2 transit,7 usable,1 quarantine; totals across locations remain 10.
Repeat receive operation cannot duplicate 8; overreceive 3 remaining when 2 transit fails.
Cancel after dispatch is refused with safe Return transfer path; source-only actor cannot receive.
Attempting generic ISSUE/ADJUST on an assigned, out-of-service or unmapped serialized asset is refused with zero movement; asset-authorized receipt replay projects one physical transition.

Dispatch quarantined2 between bins/sites leaves usable0 throughout transit and receipt; destination retains quarantine2 until independent inspection release. Usable10 transfer with1 damaged arrives usable9/quarantine1 without losing quantity.
test_plan: Fault injection between both journal legs proves zero one-sided changes; race two receipts against remaining 2 permits exact maximum. Browser transit/discrepancy paths.

Real PostgreSQL and served API tests prove tenant/company/site denial, immutable history, exact replay, changed-payload conflict, rollback before commit, durable result after lost response; parallel goroutines prove the named race invariant. Browser tests exercise actual rendered flow and errors at required widths/locales/themes; CI runs race detector. Do not close using memory-store or fixture-only proof.
issues.red: Transfer immediately credits destination or missing stock disappears on close.
issues.green: Dispatch and receipt are distinct physical facts with conserved stock and actionable discrepancies.
non_goals: Carrier purchasing, routing and intercompany commercial transfer.

issues.data_contract: Snapshot watermark and scope accompany on-hand/usable/allocated/available/quarantine/transit quantities, movement summaries,age buckets and low-stock policy version. Cost fields optional and permission-filtered; acquisition amount provenance may be exported, but no invented inventory valuation. Counts report active allocated commitments even when above physical stock, plus explicit shortage and available-to-promise clamped at zero; they never conceal the unfulfilled commitments. Consumable quantity equation applies only to consumables. Serialized equipment is counted from canonical asset projections: physical_on_hand_count=eligible_unassigned_count+assigned_count+unavailable_unassigned_count, mutually exclusive; unavailable reasons (maintenance,inspection,quarantine) are non-additive tags and never counted twice. In-transit,lost and retired/disposed are separate physical buckets outside on-hand. Serviceability remains orthogonal to custody: an assigned out-of-service asset counts once as assigned with a blocked reason, never disappears. Current eligible count is not a promise for a future time window; equipment booking remains SCHED/appointment, not consumable allocation. Typed StockCostEffect evidence is a projection bound to company,movement_id,source_receipt/issue/return ID,item/lot refs,exact quantity/UOM,acquisition_cost_source_ref,acquisition_basis_version,cost_effect_kind,amount Decimal+currency when qualified,cutoff+watermark,authority_profile_ref/version,valuation_policy_ref/version and accountant-approved external valuation_result_ref when applicable. qualification_state is UNAVAILABLE|PROVISIONAL|QUALIFIED with reason; missing amount is absent, never zero. Immutable source/effect revision and supersedes/reversal ref preserve corrections. External valuation result must bind exact movement/source set and basis/version; quantity change or stale authority invalidates qualification.
issues.api_contract: InventorySummary/ListMovements/TraceMovement/ExportStockSnapshot with bounded cursor, server filters and asynchronous authorized export. CORE events emit movement IDs and scoped references; accounting consumers reconcile by sequence/watermark and own valuation/source authority. GetStockCostEffect/ListStockCostEffects expose the typed source projection to ACCT004/008 under ACCT001 admitted authority/source profile. Qualified values are adopted only from approved procurement/acquisition policy or authorized external/accountant valuation evidence; inventory never guesses issue/return value from quantity or current catalog price.
behavior: Health distinguishes invalid negative physical bucket/projection inconsistency (integrity incident) from legitimate allocation shortage following counted loss (needs reallocation/purchase). Unsupported/unresolved valuation basis is visible UNAVAILABLE with missing evidence reason; provisional acquisition estimate stays nonposting. ACCT001 chooses authoritative valuation source, ACCT004 maps qualified evidence and ACCT008 owns period/correction policy. Stock remains usable for quantities with finance disabled; no internal FIFO/weighted-average/LIFO/depreciation/GL engine is introduced.

issues.new_code: Proposed additive domain records, application ports/commands, generated transport registration, PostgreSQL migrations and contextual productui projection in the owners named above. These are planned changes, not claims of existing implementation. Concrete proposed test files: internal/application/accounting/smb_acct_004_test.go (domain/adapter semantics), internal/application/smb_acct_004_integration_test.go (served real-DB flow), and internal/humanwork/productui/smb_acct_004_browser_test.go (consumer UI). New sales/payable/accounting directories are proposed only where named; existing owner packages are enhanced in place.
issues.data_contract: AccountingExportEnvelope pins source object/revision/digest, source kind, authority/fence, mapping/version, external identity and amount/currency totals. Batch manifest records member semantic IDs, cutoff, counts and control totals by currency. Manual export has generated/delivered/import-acknowledged/reconciled states; file generation alone is not external posting. The commercial schema registry additionally admits supplier payable bills/credits/payment observations, approved expense reimbursement refs and owner-produced stock valuation/cost effects; register exact source kind and field mapping per supported adapter. Unsupported operation stays blocked with reason and manual-export alternative only when profile validates it. STOCK011 provides typed StockCostEffect evidence with movement/source IDs, quantity/UOM, acquisition source and basis version, cost kind, qualified exact amount/currency, cutoff/watermark, authority/valuation policy refs and optional external accountant-approved valuation result. ACCT001 selects the permitted authority/profile;004 maps only QUALIFIED evidence. UNAVAILABLE/PROVISIONAL amounts are absent/blocked, never zero. No accounting or stock adapter infers COGS/value by quantity times arbitrary current price or implements a new valuation engine.
issues.api_contract: Proposed accounting.exports.preview|enqueue|status|download|record-import-ack; eligible objects are invoice, credit/debit, receipt allocation and approved expense according to adapter support. External operations route only through operation registry; item errors are independent and retry only failed/unknown items after observation. Eligibility covers all ACCT001 declared source kinds whose production source adapter and target adapter are admitted, including supplier bills/credits/payment allocations, BUSINESS_EXPENSE, EXPENSE_REIMBURSEMENT and STOCK_COST_EFFECT. This issue owns outbound adapter registrations, with disabled/unavailable behavior for source modules not yet active.
behavior: Serialize writes to same external resource or require provider precondition; sender rechecks current authority/destination/fence.
After timeout, query by semantic identity before retry; provider without idempotency/observable identity becomes manual repair, never blind resend.

Exports omit restricted employee receipts/notes and carry only authorized fields. Manual file replay/import acknowledgments cannot mark all objects reconciled without per-object/control-total evidence.

Commands authorize tenant, legal entity, resource, purpose and field access before reads that disclose data or any mutation/effect. Current authority and module enablement are rechecked at commit; guessed IDs return the standard neutral denied/not-found response.

Use SMB-CORE-002 versioned API, expected revision and tenant-scoped idempotency semantics: same canonical request returns its original receipt; a reused key with changed payload is a conflict; an observed timeout never becomes an invented success. Server validates every supplied reference and amount.

Persist domain transition, audit lineage and effect intent atomically through existing transaction/outbox boundaries; cross-store writes use owner commands and resumable orchestration, never direct foreign-table edits. New tenant tables require FORCE RLS and storage-disposition registration; immutable revisions/events require forbid_mutation.

Production financial posting and import-ready manual posting exports are activation-gated until ACCT008 period-policy resolver, current period observation and commit-time period revalidation are admitted. Build earlier adapters against contract fixtures with no production activation; do not add cyclic build dependencies. Unavailable guard returns Posting setup required and queues no live effect. Raw authorized evidence/exit exports remain permitted and explicitly labeled not posting-ready.

Security refusal may append the existing authorized denial/security telemetry receipt; prohibited side effects mean no domain money/state mutation, outbox business intent or provider call. Tests assert both allowed denial observability and absent unauthorized effects rather than demanding zero audit records.
ui_ux: Existing Integration operations page, connection Accounting tab: Ready, Queued, Observing, Reconciled, Needs action. Preview export drawer shows selected count, cutoff, currencies/totals and blocked rows; enqueue confirmation links durable batch.

Manual mode Download file explains Contains records for import, not yet posted; later Record import result requires external reference/evidence and per-row failure details. Errors deep-link to mapping/invoice owner; no raw payload or credentials displayed.

Render through existing productui, GoWebComponents SSR plus Go/WASM, governed page/widget definitions, shell and semantic theme tokens. Use contextual customer/job links, role hubs, pins and My Work; do not add a permanent global navigation destination for this story.

Verify 1280x720, 390px and 320px, light/dark, en-US/de-DE/ar RTL. Keep currency code and unambiguous local dates/timezones visible; store canonical decimals and timestamps independently of display. Use labeled controls, semantic headings/tables, keyboard-operable actions, error summary linked to fields, visible focus, and return focus to the invoking control after dialogs.

Bound loading with a retry action and retained filter/draft state. Distinguish no records, no matches, dependency unavailable, denied, offline, stale/conflict, pending observation and completed states. Disable money-changing submission offline with a clear explanation; never queue invisible financial effects or silently overwrite a newer revision. After success announce the durable record/status and retain a direct detail link.
acceptance: Crash after external invoice creation but before receipt persists resolves by observation to one external invoice, not duplicate posting.
Batch of 10 with one invalid mapping sends the permitted 9 only when explicit partial policy is selected and displays 9 successful/1 blocked; no generic Complete badge.
Downloaded manual export remains Unconfirmed externally until imported evidence reconciles control totals and record identities.
Cross-tenant reference injection, stale revision, denied role and crash after domain commit before HTTP response must leave either no effect or one replayable committed effect.

StockCostEffect40 with verified source/basis/version/current authority and QUALIFIED state exports40 once, preserving lineage; the same movement with missing or provisional valuation/acquisition amount is blocked, never exported as0 or recomputed from quantity. Corrected40 supersedes through approved reversal/new effect and retains both evidence records.

Parameterized source-kind contract matrix: CUSTOMER_INVOICE100 routes AR; SUPPLIER_BILL60, SUPPLIER_CREDIT10 and SUPPLIER_PAYMENT20 route AP and conserve remaining30; BUSINESS_EXPENSE25 and EXPENSE_REIMBURSEMENT25 retain separate source obligations; STOCK_COST_EFFECT40 uses STOCK011 qualified cost-effect evidence with declared acquisition/external-approved valuation basis, never a new valuation calculation; PAYROLL_JOURNAL uses PAYGL adapter only. Assert each target kind, authority, entity/currency, canonical source/external identity and control totals before/after crash+retry.

Every ACCT001 admitted source-kind registration has one concrete fixture asserting wire output and disabled/unsupported behavior; absent production source adapter or period guard blocks enqueue/import-ready posting export with named reason, never claims generic support. No payroll row can enter AR mapping.

With otherwise qualified connection/mapping but no period guard, financial write/import-ready export activation is refused and no posting occurs. Admit the reviewed guard with an open period, then the same authorized fixture can activate; closing the period before commit blocks send again.
test_plan: Target commands after implementation: go test -count=1 ./internal/application/accounting -run '^TestTodo_SMB_ACCT_004($|_)'; go test -count=1 ./internal/application -run '^TestTodo_SMB_ACCT_004($|_)'; go test -count=1 ./internal/humanwork/productui -run '^TestTodo_SMB_ACCT_004($|_)'. Use internal/data/pgtest and task .artifacts temp/cache directories. Concurrency tests run goroutines; -race is CI-only on a supported host, not falsely claimed on Windows arm64.

Unit/property: use the explicit numeric, status and lifecycle oracles in this issue; vary ordering, duplicate identities, quantity boundaries and missing policy inputs. Assert outputs and durable outcomes, not merely successful calls.

Integration/API: use internal/data/pgtest with real tenant RLS connections and served generated HTTP/RPC handlers. Run the positive flow, denial, stale revision and idempotent retry, restart the owner and assert the same authoritative record and outbox state.

Race/fault: execute concurrent commands against one expected revision or monetary remainder; inject failure before commit, after commit before reply, before external send and after ambiguous external reply where applicable. Assert unique intent/receipt, no over-allocation and recoverability.

Browser: exercise the concrete route and controls above against the running Go server and real persisted fixture; capture post-action screenshots at all declared widths/themes/locales. Include keyboard, focus, validation, empty/error/denied/offline/conflict and long translated data.
