New sales/payable/accounting directories are proposed only where named; existing owner packages are enhanced in place.
issues.data_contract: AccountingObservation captures tenant/connection/account/object/version/event, observed/effective times, hash, authority decision and normalized invoice/receipt/credit facts. Sync checkpoint only advances after durable ingestion and explicit complete-page handling. Tombstones/voids preserve prior records; missing snapshot completeness cannot imply deletion.
issues.api_contract: Proposed accounting.observations.ingest|compare|quarantine|status consumes existing sync/webhook jobs. Applied external updates invoke billing typed observation commands, never direct table writes. Current authority, external version ordering and identity crosswalk validate before projection. This issue owns inbound adapter registrations for ACCT001 source kinds admitted by source-authority and provider capability; payables/credits/payment observations resolve BILL012, reimbursement observations BILL016, stock-cost observations stock owner. Disabled source modules remain observe-only/quarantined rather than gaining write authority.
behavior: Duplicate events are idempotent, out-of-order versions cannot regress state, contradictory data opens discrepancy.
External paid status without qualifying settlement evidence remains externally reported rather than platform-confirmed cash; approved profile defines trusted source semantics.
Local authoritative invoice differences become discrepancies with proposed repair; external master updates only permitted fields and retains local notes/access policy.

Commands authorize tenant, legal entity, resource, purpose and field access before reads that disclose data or any mutation/effect. Current authority and module enablement are rechecked at commit; guessed IDs return the standard neutral denied/not-found response.

Use SMB-CORE-002 versioned API, expected revision and tenant-scoped idempotency semantics: same canonical request returns its original receipt; a reused key with changed payload is a conflict; an observed timeout never becomes an invented success. Server validates every supplied reference and amount.

Persist domain transition, audit lineage and effect intent atomically through existing transaction/outbox boundaries; cross-store writes use owner commands and resumable orchestration, never direct foreign-table edits. New tenant tables require FORCE RLS and storage-disposition registration; immutable revisions/events require forbid_mutation.

Supplier payment/credit observations route to BILL012 payable allocation owner, not customer receivable; supplier-paid bank net amounts require source-profile reconciliation just as customer receipt amounts do. Expense reimbursements resolve the originating obligation. Stock valuation observations stay stock-authority scoped.

BILL007 owns the one additive persisted commercial receipt schema extension in internal/data/providerreceipts and wire verification extensions in providerreceipt; BILL015/ACCT005 consume it. Existing parser/store currently admit payroll/IAM, so explicitly migrate/register payment/accounting families and account/connection+event identity with stable legacy schema semantics. Use durable authenticated webhook ingress and providerreceipts transaction before applying domain allocation; process-local verifier memory is not sufficient for replay safety.

Security refusal may append the existing authorized denial/security telemetry receipt; prohibited side effects mean no domain money/state mutation, outbox business intent or provider call. Tests assert both allowed denial observability and absent unauthorized effects rather than demanding zero audit records.
ui_ux: Invoice Accounting panel shows External status, Source/account, Observed at and Freshness, plus Local collection status separately when evidence differs.

Existing Integration operations inbound run detail lists fetched/applied/duplicate/quarantined counts and checkpoint; rows explain Identity unresolved, Authority conflict or Stale version with review links. Staff cannot edit provider observation in place.

Render through existing productui, GoWebComponents SSR plus Go/WASM, governed page/widget definitions, shell and semantic theme tokens. Use contextual customer/job links, role hubs, pins and My Work; do not add a permanent global navigation destination for this story.

Verify 1280x720, 390px and 320px, light/dark, en-US/de-DE/ar RTL. Keep currency code and unambiguous local dates/timezones visible; store canonical decimals and timestamps independently of display. Use labeled controls, semantic headings/tables, keyboard-operable actions, error summary linked to fields, visible focus, and return focus to the invoking control after dialogs.

Bound loading with a retry action and retained filter/draft state. Distinguish no records, no matches, dependency unavailable, denied, offline, stale/conflict, pending observation and completed states. Disable money-changing submission offline with a clear explanation; never queue invisible financial effects or silently overwrite a newer revision. After success announce the durable record/status and retain a direct detail link.
acceptance: Provider event v3 paid followed by v2 open never regresses accepted v3 observation; duplicate v3 leaves balances unchanged.
Expired webhook signature, wrong external account and cross-tenant ID fail before domain effects; incomplete pagination never deletes missing invoices.
Restart after durable ingest before checkpoint reruns safely and shows one receipt/allocation.
Cross-tenant reference injection, stale revision, denied role and crash after domain commit before HTTP response must leave either no effect or one replayable committed effect.

Inbound matrix with AR invoice60 and AP bill60 sharing external textID42: supplier payment20 reduces only AP to40; AR remains60. Supplier credit10 then yields AP30. Wrong source kind/entity/account, disabled module and stale revision cannot route to another owner; replay/restart preserves values.

Observe the same employee reimbursement25 via payroll and accounting aliases resolved to one originating expense-obligation family: reimbursed25, never50. STOCK_COST_EFFECT40 stays stock-authority observation and does not create invoice/expense duplicate; PAYGL input remains payroll-owned. Each admitted family has positive, wrong-kind, stale-version, disabled-module and restart fixtures.

Restart parser/verifier process after authenticated commercial callback persisted but before domain projection; replay finds the same durable providerreceipts entry and creates one domain outcome. Same provider event text across different admitted connection/accounts cannot collide; conflicting same scoped ID/payload is quarantined. Existing payroll/IAM receipt fixtures remain readable and unchanged.

issues.new_code: Proposed additive domain records, application ports/commands, generated transport registration, PostgreSQL migrations and contextual productui projection in the owners named above. These are planned changes, not claims of existing implementation. The shared purpose-union extension is implemented once by SMB-BILL-017; this story only binds customer refund eligibility/approval to that contract and provider adapter. Concrete proposed test files: internal/domains/workorderbilling/smb_bill_009_test.go (domain/adapter semantics), internal/application/smb_bill_009_integration_test.go (served real-DB flow), and internal/humanwork/productui/smb_bill_009_browser_test.go (consumer UI). issues.data_contract: RefundRequest binds customer credit/original receipt, exact amount/currency, purpose/source ref, destination token or original-provider operation ref, approval digest, reserved remainder and settlement instruction. Refund status PROPOSED/APPROVED/QUEUED/AMBIGUOUS/SETTLED/FAILED/REVERSED is separate from credit status. Dispute observation identifies source receipt/provider claim and restricted evidence. One monetary authority is BILL007 receipt allocation projection. Track gross settled G, confirmed refunded R, confirmed final reversal/chargeback V, disputed hold D, and pending refund reservations P as separately identified exact amounts, never derive amount from scalar receipt status. Supported funds F=max(0,G-R-V); active invoice allocation A is at most F and at most the current obligation after credits. Unallocated credit U=max(0,F-A). Refund availability is max(0,U-D-P), additionally bounded by approved remedy eligibility. Excess confirmed external recovery L=max(0,R+V-G) is a separate loss/recovery discrepancy, never newly minted credit or silently increased customer debt. Each external event has stable source identity/finality and is applied once. Pending/ambiguous refund reserves remain until observation; events never erase original source facts. Eligibility proof issued to017 binds this receipt source version, reservation fence and exact available amount;017 cannot calculate a competing balance.
issues.api_contract: Proposed billing.refunds.preview|request|approve|submit|observe|cancel-before-send; consume SMB-BILL-017 validated commercial subject/constructor and existing submission ports; SMB-BILL-017 alone owns typed-source wire/storage migration and payroll compatibility. If no admitted provider/rail supports refund, return EXTERNAL_ACTION_REQUIRED and record externally executed refund evidence through an authorized observation path.
behavior: Revalidate credit availability, destination authority and approval immediately before send; a timeout after send holds the reservation pending observation.
Never collect raw bank/card details in refund UI or logs. Destination changes invoke existing protected destination/step-up/approval controls where applicable.
Disputed/reversed original receipts block incompatible refund and route Human Work review; no automatic customer debit or attempt to win disputes without authorized action.

Commands authorize tenant, legal entity, resource, purpose and field access before reads that disclose data or any mutation/effect. Current authority and module enablement are rechecked at commit; guessed IDs return the standard neutral denied/not-found response.

Use SMB-CORE-002 versioned API, expected revision and tenant-scoped idempotency semantics: same canonical request returns its original receipt; a reused key with changed payload is a conflict; an observed timeout never becomes an invented success. Server validates every supplied reference and amount.

Persist domain transition, audit lineage and effect intent atomically through existing transaction/outbox boundaries; cross-store writes use owner commands and resumable orchestration, never direct foreign-table edits. New tenant tables require FORCE RLS and storage-disposition registration; immutable revisions/events require forbid_mutation.

Refund/dispute financial records link the JOB008 complaint/warranty case instead of creating a parallel case. Remedy authorization records credit, cash refund, replacement and no-charge rework together under one original delivery/source allowance; legitimate combined remedies require explicit approval, and accidental duplicate remedy application is rejected.

Before-send chargeback invalidates a conflicting unsent refund reservation and approval; revalidation blocks send. If refund was already sent/ambiguous, retain its reservation and observe before any new effect; final funds/recovery shortage is reconciled under BILL007 policy, never hidden by an allocation rewrite. Provider fees remain separate merchant cost and do not reduce the gross customer receipt.

Security refusal may append the existing authorized denial/security telemetry receipt; prohibited side effects mean no domain money/state mutation, outbox business intent or provider call. Tests assert both allowed denial observability and absent unauthorized effects rather than demanding zero audit records.
ui_ux: Customer credit > Refund drawer shows Available, Amount, Original payment, masked destination, expected action and approval requirement. Explicit Request refund then Approve/Submit roles; confirmation is Queued, never Refunded until observed.

Refund detail shows timeline/receipt and Needs investigation for ambiguity with authorized observe/repair link. Dispute banner names amount/status and required action without exposing sensitive provider payload; unsupported route explains external action and evidence capture.

Render through existing productui, GoWebComponents SSR plus Go/WASM, governed page/widget definitions, shell and semantic theme tokens. Use contextual customer/job links, role hubs, pins and My Work; do not add a permanent global navigation destination for this story.

Verify 1280x720, 390px and 320px, light/dark, en-US/de-DE/ar RTL. Keep currency code and unambiguous local dates/timezones visible; store canonical decimals and timestamps independently of display. Use labeled controls, semantic headings/tables, keyboard-operable actions, error summary linked to fields, visible focus, and return focus to the invoking control after dialogs.

Bound loading with a retry action and retained filter/draft state. Distinguish no records, no matches, dependency unavailable, denied, offline, stale/conflict, pending observation and completed states. Disable money-changing submission offline with a clear explanation; never queue invisible financial effects or silently overwrite a newer revision. After success announce the durable record/status and retain a direct detail link.
acceptance: Two USD 30 requests against USD 40 credit cannot both reserve; one can reserve USD 30 leaving USD 10.
Provider timeout after successful send preserves one instruction and AMBIGUOUS state; readback completes without a second transfer.
Payroll settlement fixtures remain unchanged under new typed purpose; rejected/unsupported customer refund cannot be coerced into a payroll worker/run instruction.
Cross-tenant reference injection, stale revision, denied role and crash after domain commit before HTTP response must leave either no effect or one replayable committed effect.

Race fixture: G100, obligation75, A75, creditU25, pending unsent refundP25; final chargebackV25 arriving before send cancels/fences the unsent reservation, leaves F75/A75/U0/due0 and sends zero refund. Reverse execution order produces one sent/ambiguous refund with P25 held until observed, never a second send.

If that sent refund25 settles after chargeback25, G100/R25/V25 =>F50/A50, current obligation75 gives due25 and U0; UI says Refund settled / Chargeback25 / Balance25 with lineage. If chargeback100 follows settled refund25, due stays capped at obligation75 and excess25 is Needs review, never resurrected cancelled charge.

findings.finding: A pending refund reserves credit and an ambiguous send holds it, but no interleaving oracle handles a provider chargeback/reversal arriving while or after that refund settles. This can permit double return of the original funds or resurrect cancelled invoice debt.

Add exact numerical and browser Needs review oracles.

issues.data_contract:
ExternalParticipant{tenant,id,verified_identity_ref,state,revocation_epoch}; PartyRepresentationGrant{participant,company,party,role CUSTOMER_CONTACT|CUSTOMER_APPROVER|SUPPLIER_CONTACT|SUPPLIER_APPROVER,resource_scope,action_ceiling,field_ceiling,expiry,granted_by,revision,epoch}; signatory authority is action/resource/version limited and can be narrower than read access. Same human may have separate employee/external contexts with no privilege union. ExternalParticipant lifecycle ACTIVE|SUSPENDED|REVOKED; representation lifecycle INVITED|ACTIVE|SUSPENDED|ENDED|EXPIRED with explicit effective interval, source-of-authority and current epoch. Reactivation requires current identity/policy revalidation and new grant revision; revocation cannot be reversed by replaying old invitation. Session presence is not representation state.

External access continuity refinement: A verified email/contact endpoint change for the same issuer+subject updates contact evidence only and leaves existing unexpired grants in place, subject to fresh authentication and ordinary current grant rechecks. A different issuer+subject is never silently mapped or granted prior authority: use an explicitly audited rebind policy with provider-independent proof if separately authorized, otherwise require a fresh invitation/grant. Preserve existing audit receipts and authored conversation/document attribution; recipient exposure always checks current grant.
issues.api_contract:
Canonical protocol: Protobuf and generated EndpointDefinition; proposed messages below are additions, never replacements for existing messages. IDs/refs are opaque UTF-8 strings validated against typed registered entity kinds and trusted scope; expected revisions are uint64>0 unless explicitly create-absent; keys are bounded nonempty strings under CORE002. Display name is display_name everywhere. Dates use LocalDate, instants google.protobuf.Timestamp, zones IANA strings, quantities/decimals/money existing common value messages (never floats). Entity-ref arrays and enums follow the data_contract closed vocabulary; source_versions is a bounded list of {source_ref,revision,digest}; field masks select authorized declared fields only. RoleInterval={role,effective_from,effective_to?,owner_ref?}; TypedAnswer={field_id,schema_version,oneof typed primitive/entity/document ref}; all other named record shapes are explicitly defined by this issue data_contract/owning domain. Unknown fields/enum values reject under existing strict wire policy. Principal/tenant/roles are authenticated context; requested scope/representation are selectors checked by server, never authority.
Each proposed query states its exact required/optional fields and returned projection; it has no business mutations. Each proposed command states its own revision owner and output; no blanket WriteEnvelope is added. Mutation success may be committed receipt or typed pending Operation for cross-owner work; response does not mean provider success. Replayed key returns same result; changed payload conflicts. List optional page_size is 1..100 and cursor is signed/bound principal+tenant+company/representation+filters+watermark+expiry. Existing workorder RPC-style HTTP aliases remain, additive /v1 routes below are generated. New SMB endpoint disposition is PHASE_3/4 with correct field classification, never inherited PHASE_1/CONFIDENTIAL_HR.
ErrorDetail mapping: malformed400, unauthenticated401, disclosed-denied403, hidden/absent404, idempotency/state-conflict409, stale revision/precondition412, quota429, unavailable503, deadline504; typed pending202 plus operation resource. Include safe field violations/retry class/correlation and current revision only when authorized. Required security/refusal audit is retained; zero business-success effects on refusal.

All proposed record projections/commands use the schema field names above plus the data_contract closed enums. Required strings are nonempty and bounded by existing field policy; typed user descriptions/evidence obey the concrete limits in UI/behavior. Validation resolves every EntityRef under current scope before relation expansion. Create commands do not require a nonexistent current record revision; explicitly listed parent/source revision preconditions still apply. Queries and simulations do not use a mutation key unless expressly listed as read-artifact operation. No generic dynamically chosen remote method can be invoked.

Configured IdP owns credential recovery; portal offers the configured IdP sign-in/recovery path and requires fresh authentication before portal access. If the returned issuer+subject is unchanged, resolve the same external participant and retain current unexpired grants, then recheck issuer status, participant state, grant revision/epoch, expiry and field/action ceilings. Recovery alone creates no identity or grant. Do not require revoke/reinvite for an unchanged principal changing email/contact endpoint. If issuer+subject changes, never auto-transfer grants: require an explicit audited rebind under a separately authorized, provider-independent proof policy or treat the identity as new and require fresh party invitation and grant.
behavior: Authenticated identity alone grants zero business data; active representation and current resource/action policy required on every read/write/search/download.
Customer-to-customer, supplier-to-customer and employee-to-portal separation holds even for one email/human. No automatic association from matching email/domain.
Revocation increments epoch and invalidates session/short-lived grant/download validation at request time; stale signed tokens cannot continue through cached page state.

Cross-company project participation still requires existing bilateral policy; a simple customer account that is not another tenant uses scoped participant representation, not fictional home tenant/project membership.

All writes run through the registered application capability with trusted tenant/actor and current organization/resource/field authority, expected revision, canonical digest and idempotency key. Equal retries replay the original receipt, changed payload rejects; failed validation/auth/revision conflict writes zero domain/business-success rows, business-success journal/outbox entries and provider requests; preserve required sanitized security/refusal audit through its current owner. Reads, search, counts, exports and event payloads enforce the same current scope. Persist domain mutation, append-only journal and outbox in the owning store transaction with tenant RLS and storage-disposition entries.

Configured IdP owns credential recovery; portal offers the configured IdP sign-in/recovery path and requires fresh authentication before portal access. If the returned issuer+subject is unchanged, resolve the same external participant and retain current unexpired grants, then recheck issuer status, participant state, grant revision/epoch, expiry and field/action ceilings. If issuer+subject changes, never auto-transfer grants: require an explicit audited rebind under a separately authorized, provider-independent proof policy or treat the identity as new and require fresh party invitation and grant.

A verified email/contact endpoint change for the same issuer+subject updates contact evidence only and leaves existing unexpired grants in place, subject to fresh authentication and ordinary current grant rechecks. A different issuer+subject is never silently mapped or granted prior authority: use an explicitly audited rebind policy with provider-independent proof if separately authorized, otherwise require a fresh invitation/grant. Preserve existing audit receipts and authored conversation/document attribution; recipient exposure always checks current grant.

Credential recovery and MFA/password recovery remain at the configured IdP. The portal does not store credential or recovery secrets or mint an alternate recovery credential. After IdP recovery require fresh authentication; neutral handling of unknown/unauthorized portal participants; no raw authorization codes or invite tokens in URL history/referrer/logs. Endpoint verification challenges use Contact owner digest-only, single-use, expiry and attempt/rate controls. Failed/expired/replayed endpoint challenges and stale revisions create no endpoint/grant change; preserve required sanitized security evidence under its owner.
ui_ux: Exact proposed route contract: API-only contract; portal /workspace/portal/{company}/home and context chooser owned by SMB-PORTAL-002.

Consumes portal shell and invitation/represented-party chooser in SMB-PORTAL-002. Scope errors render Access ended or No shared work, preserving safe sign-out/help actions without exposing whether another party exists.
Sample authorized projection includes represented company/party name and permitted action labels only; workforce People/Organization/Admin routes remain inaccessible from external context.

Use existing internal/humanwork/productui and projectui page/floorplan primitives, GoWebComponents Go SSR + Go/WASM, semantic theme tokens and authorized projections. Qualify 1280x720, 390px and 320px widths, light/dark, en-US/de-DE/ar RTL; translated text, locale dates/numbers, screen-reader labels, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion. Entry is a role-relevant Home pin, My Work item, contextual project link or search result; do not add a permanent global navigation destination.

Each query has bounded loading with status text, genuine empty-state action, typed denied/not-found and retryable error; partial/freshness state is explicit. Mutations preserve drafts on validation/server failure, disable duplicate submit while pending, show server receipt only after durable commit, and refetch on conflict without discarding edits. Offline state allows only explicitly saved draft capture and never claims committed work. Browser Back/Forward and reload preserve authorized route/filter state; focus moves to error summary on failure and returns to initiating control after dialogs.

Unauthenticated portal entry offers Sign in using the company-configured IdP. Recovery links to that IdP's configured recovery experience; portal gives neutral return guidance and does not collect or create a custom credential recovery secret. Unknown, expired or revoked portal access receives neutral status after fresh authentication.

Keyboard flow uses labeled sign-in/endpoint fields, visible focus, error summary linked to fields, paste-friendly IdP code entry when supplied by the IdP, and announces provider redirect/return status. Network/provider failure preserves no credential material and permits a fresh sign-in attempt; old authorization codes are not restored from browser history.

After successful fresh authentication, same issuer+subject resolves the existing external participant. Display a represented-party picker only after live grant checks; if no active grant, show that access needs a current invitation. Never show cached party/work/request/document data until current authorization succeeds.

Mobile 320/390px keeps one-column forms, no clipped provider return controls, and no horizontal scrolling; loading, neutral acknowledgement, rate limit, provider outage, expired invitation, stale endpoint revision, denied rebind and success states use text plus icon/state label rather than color alone. Support en-US/de-DE/ar RTL, locale-safe dates, screen-reader labels and reduced motion.

Supplier offer preserves supplier SKU,item/UOM,price/currency,validity and source revision. Proposal snapshots usable,active demand,firm inbound remainder and uncertainty; unknown deliveries never count usable now. Every write authenticates human/app/device origin and authorizes tenant, company, site and record before effects; revalidate on commit. Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL RLS, storage-disposition registration, append-only fact triggers, immutable request digest and unique tenant+operation key; exact duplicate returns durable result, changed payload conflicts. Business update and outbox/audit receipt commit together; failure before commit changes nothing and failure after commit is resolved by operation lookup, never blind replay. Cross-domain effects call typed application capabilities and reconcile partial outcomes. Commands and offline/import batches bind the active tenant recovery epoch from SMB-CORE-002; restored or migrated stale epochs are refused for revalidation, not automatically replayed against the older state.

behavior: Automatic proposal trigger is projected eligible supply = usable-on-hand minus active demand plus firm inbound due inside horizon; trigger only when that value is strictly below Reorder below, unless a separately identified unmet job need explicitly requests replenishment. Then needed=max(0,Refill-to-projected eligible supply), exact pack rounding upward with excess shown. Validation requires 0<=Reorder below<=Refill to. Do not subtract demand twice: active allocation already reduces available; unallocated firm job demand is additional exactly once.
Open proposed/approved requests are recognized to prevent repeated suggested buys; cancellation reopens only genuinely unsatisfied quantity.
Supplier price/lead-time stale or unavailable creates Review required with alternate quote request; no default zero-cost order.
Policy auto-proposal permitted after explicit approval; PO issue still follows spend and supplier dispatch controls.

After trigger, supplier minimum_order_quantity M and pack size P use proposed=P*ceil(max(needed,M)/P) in exact base units; if resulting excess violates configured approved surplus limit, block for review rather than auto-propose. Minimum monetary order cannot be inferred from quantity: show explicit separate supplier constraint and require manual reviewed aggregation.

Policy editor labels Reorder below, Refill to, Preferred supplier, Pack size, Lead time; live example explains rounding. Review allows deselect/edit quantities and shows changed calculations.

Create purchase requests summary groups compatible supplier/currency/site lines without merging permissions; success links resulting requests and notes awaiting approval. Empty states distinguish All stocked, No policies and Data stale.

issues.api_contract:
Canonical protocol: Protobuf and generated EndpointDefinition; proposed messages below are additions, never replacements for existing messages. IDs/refs are opaque UTF-8 strings validated against typed registered entity kinds and trusted scope; expected revisions are uint64>0 unless explicitly create-absent; keys are bounded nonempty strings under CORE002. Display name is display_name everywhere. Dates use LocalDate, instants google.protobuf.Timestamp, zones IANA strings, quantities/decimals/money existing common value messages (never floats). Entity-ref arrays and enums follow the data_contract closed vocabulary; source_versions is a bounded list of {source_ref,revision,digest}; field masks select authorized declared fields only. RoleInterval={role,effective_from,effective_to?,owner_ref?}; TypedAnswer={field_id,schema_version,oneof typed primitive/entity/document ref}; all other named record shapes are explicitly defined by this issue data_contract/owning domain. Unknown fields/enum values reject under existing strict wire policy. Principal/tenant/roles are authenticated context; requested scope/representation are selectors checked by server, never authority.
Each proposed query states its exact required/optional fields and returned projection; it has no business mutations. Each proposed command states its own revision owner and output; no blanket WriteEnvelope is added. Mutation success may be committed receipt or typed pending Operation for cross-owner work; response does not mean provider success. Replayed key returns same result; changed payload conflicts. List optional page_size is 1..100 and cursor is signed/bound principal+tenant+company/representation+filters+watermark+expiry. Existing workorder RPC-style HTTP aliases remain, additive /v1 routes below are generated. New SMB endpoint disposition is PHASE_3/4 with correct field classification, never inherited PHASE_1/CONFIDENTIAL_HR.
ErrorDetail mapping: malformed400, unauthenticated401, disclosed-denied403, hidden/absent404, idempotency/state-conflict409, stale revision/precondition412, quota429, unavailable503, deadline504; typed pending202 plus operation resource. Include safe field violations/retry class/correlation and current revision only when authorized. Required security/refusal audit is retained; zero business-success effects on refusal.

All proposed record projections/commands use the schema field names above plus the data_contract closed enums. Required strings are nonempty and bounded by existing field policy; typed user descriptions/evidence obey the concrete limits in UI/behavior. Validation resolves every EntityRef under current scope before relation expansion. Create commands do not require a nonexistent current record revision; explicitly listed parent/source revision preconditions still apply. Queries and simulations do not use a mutation key unless expressly listed as read-artifact operation. No generic dynamically chosen remote method can be invoked.
behavior: Unstructured notes cannot bypass required offering fields or attachment scan status.
User may request urgency, but assigned priority and response promise derive from authorized service policy; no hardcoded contractual SLA.
Triage supports duplicate-link without deleting original request and clear decline reason. Waiting-for-customer pauses clock only where pinned policy allows.
Failed handoff retains accepted intent plus pending action; authorized retry reuses same key; no orphan request marked completed without job receipt.

All writes run through the registered application capability with trusted tenant/actor and current organization/resource/field authority, expected revision, canonical digest and idempotency key. Equal retries replay the original receipt, changed payload rejects; failed validation/auth/revision conflict writes zero domain/business-success rows, business-success journal/outbox entries and provider requests; preserve required sanitized security/refusal audit through its current owner. Reads, search, counts, exports and event payloads enforce the same current scope. Persist domain mutation, append-only journal and outbox in the owning store transaction with tenant RLS and storage-disposition entries.

Concurrent Accept with different client keys is fenced by the request unique conversion_id. Cancel while target create may have succeeded enters CANCEL_REVIEW; reconcile target receipt then cancel through workorder owner or confirm no-create before closing request. Never issue a fresh create or erase an unknown accepted effect.

AnswerRequestQuestions applies only to current WAITING_CUSTOMER typed question set and returns TRIAGE when complete; partial answers preserve remaining requirements. LinkDuplicate retains original request/source/visibility and an authorized canonical reference. Reopen DECLINED/CANCELLED requires reason and current authority; if conversion already exists it routes follow-up/case to the existing job rather than creating a second job. Decline disposition SPAM suppresses automatic outbound notices unless explicitly approved.

Typed evidence references retain scan/classification/status; notes are immutable corrections with internal visibility by default.
behavior: Starting execution checks current assigned-worker/project/work-order authorization and permitted workflow phase; appointment arrival is not job completion.
Required checklist items cannot be skipped. Quantity over approved scope is refused or creates an approved change request, never hidden truncation.
Offline draft preserves explicitly saved form/evidence metadata with no secret or entire HR/customer cache; submitting after reconnect revalidates state and reports stale evidence safely.
Evidence uploaded/pending scan is not accepted proof; completion distinguishes submitted, verified and accepted progress. Approved labor remains FTIME owner, not a second timer in this page.

Offline allowlist: draft-only checklist answer values declared low-sensitivity by published schema, quantity input, draft comment explicitly classified for local storage, and attachment filename/size/hash metadata. No site codes, restricted notes, original document bytes, pay/customer financial data or unapproved field is cached. Use existing encrypted draft owner, tenant/user/session binding and bounded configured expiry; logout/revocation purges local drafts/cached projections. Reauthentication restores only server-authorized fields, otherwise offers safe discard/re-entry. Failed required item means unresolved even if answered; passing/reviewed correction must be appended before completion.

Offline revocation cannot remotely erase unreachable storage: local drafts have bounded encrypted lease/expiry; purge occurs on logout or observed revocation/reconnect, with server denial on any submit. No protected bytes are cached even during lease. Revoke-while-offline test proves lease expiry or reconnect purge/refusal, not instantaneous remote wipe.

CommitImport binds import/lineage identity, target_profile, approved simulation digest, expected operation revision, stable idempotency key and approval evidence; the server resolves tenant/actor and validates current authority before each component effect. GetImportStatus is an authorized read with scoped pagination for row/component receipts. RetryImportRows binds existing operation/lineage, selected row/component IDs, approved successor simulation digest when needed, expected revision and stable logical effect keys; previously completed components are not resent. CORE001 must separately admit phase, IntentDefinition/capability bindings, transport manifest and field classifications before serving the methods. CRM007 implements the business-relationships target adapter using these shared contracts, never a second job engine.
behavior: Execution checks current authority per row; expired approval or disabled module blocks remaining rows and preserves successful receipts.

Restart resumes from durable checkpoints and deduplicates receipt-before-checkpoint crashes. Compensation is domain corrective capability, never SQL deletion of imported history.
Failed unresolved duplicates return to review without undoing valid records.

Row aggregation distinguishes REJECTED-before-effect from PARTIAL-after-effect. Resume dispatches only incomplete components under their original logical keys; corrections to successful components require domain corrective intents. Counts include partial rows explicitly, not under wholly failed.

No issue may consume shortage-blocked reservation without new validated allocation/fence; never silently drop promises or refuse recording real shrinkage.

An observation's client timestamp does not prove physical movement ordering. Rebase only for movements confirmed before an enforceable staffed count window; if shelf observation and a movement overlap or chronology is uncertain, keep count draft and require recount. The short final database fence alone is insufficient evidence.

Canonical protocol: Protobuf and generated EndpointDefinition; proposed messages below are additions, never replacements for existing messages. IDs/refs are opaque UTF-8 strings validated against typed registered entity kinds and trusted scope; expected revisions are uint64>0 unless explicitly create-absent; keys are bounded nonempty strings under CORE002. Display name is display_name everywhere. Dates use LocalDate, instants google.protobuf.Timestamp, zones IANA strings, quantities/decimals/money existing common value messages (never floats). Entity-ref arrays and enums follow the data_contract closed vocabulary; source_versions is a bounded list of {source_ref,revision,digest}; field masks select authorized declared fields only. RoleInterval={role,effective_from,effective_to?,owner_ref?}; TypedAnswer={field_id,schema_version,oneof typed primitive/entity/document ref}; all other named record shapes are explicitly defined by this issue data_contract/owning domain. Unknown fields/enum values reject under existing strict wire policy. Principal/tenant/roles are authenticated context; requested scope/representation are selectors checked by server, never authority.
Each proposed query states its exact required/optional fields and returned projection; it has no business mutations. Each proposed command states its own revision owner and output; no blanket WriteEnvelope is added. Mutation success may be committed receipt or typed pending Operation for cross-owner work; response does not mean provider success. Replayed key returns same result; changed payload conflicts. List optional page_size is 1..100 and cursor is signed/bound principal+tenant+company/representation+filters+watermark+expiry. Existing workorder RPC-style HTTP aliases remain, additive /v1 routes below are generated. New SMB endpoint disposition is PHASE_3/4 with correct field classification, never inherited PHASE_1/CONFIDENTIAL_HR.
ErrorDetail mapping: malformed400, unauthenticated401, disclosed-denied403, hidden/absent404, idempotency/state-conflict409, stale revision/precondition412, quota429, unavailable503, deadline504; typed pending202 plus operation resource. Include safe field violations/retry class/correlation and current revision only when authorized. Required security/refusal audit is retained; zero business-success effects on refusal.

behavior: Warranty eligibility reads versioned agreement/service policy and evidence; expired/unknown entitlement gives explained review, not hardcoded legal rejection.
Case can reopen for a new allegation with retained history; close requires explicit outcome and unresolved obligation disposition.
Corrective job references original accepted job and scope, never rewrites prior evidence or marks the first job incomplete retroactively.
Customer-visible updates are intentionally published statements, not automatic replication of internal investigation notes. Financial and operational resolutions have separate receipt states.

All writes run through the registered application capability with trusted tenant/actor and current organization/resource/field authority, expected revision, canonical digest and idempotency key. Equal retries replay the original receipt, changed payload rejects; failed validation/auth/revision conflict writes zero domain/business-success rows, business-success journal/outbox entries and provider requests; preserve required sanitized security/refusal audit through its current owner. Reads, search, counts, exports and event payloads enforce the same current scope. Persist domain mutation, append-only journal and outbox in the owning store transaction with tenant RLS and storage-disposition entries.

No-charge warranty rework requires explicit current policy decision with evidence; it changes only the corrective job chargeability, never original billing. Superseding/reopening a proposal reconciles existing remedy receipts and dispatches only approved deltas; replaying acceptance cannot create another remedy. Customer acceptance confirms published resolution under PORTAL action scope; internal spending/refund approval remains separate.

RejectCaseResolution cannot revoke an already executed refund/corrective job; it returns case to INVESTIGATING and records existing remedies for further review. CloseServiceCase requires every mandatory remedy observed complete or explicitly dispositioned under policy; pending provider outcome remains unresolved and cannot be mislabeled paid/refunded. Customer acceptance and rejection use exact proposal digest/grant; staff close uses independent case authority.

The portal exposes a typed command owned by ExternalParticipant/Invitation application orchestration and delegates endpoint normalization, verification challenge and revision storage to existing internal/domains/contact (CONTACT-001/002). Proposed additive API: UpdateExternalContactEndpointRequest{participant_ref,company_ref,expected_endpoint_revision,new_endpoint,purpose,challenge_ref,idempotency_key}; response UpdateExternalContactEndpointResponse{endpoint_revision,endpoint_update_receipt,superseded_invitation_refs}. Verify proposed endpoint under Contact owner policy; same-subject contact changes retain valid current grants. A successful endpoint revision change supersedes only unaccepted invitations bound to the old endpoint revision. It does not revoke grants or force reinvitation of the same participant. New invitations bind the new endpoint revision. UpdateExternalContactEndpoint command is scoped to the authenticated external participant and company party grant plus current endpoint revision. Idempotency digest binds participant_ref, company_ref, expected_endpoint_revision, normalized new_endpoint, purpose and challenge_ref. IDs/refs are opaque UTF-8 strings validated against typed registered entity kinds and trusted scope; expected revisions are uint64>0 unless explicitly create-absent; keys are bounded nonempty strings under CORE002. Display name is display_name everywhere. Dates use LocalDate, instants google.protobuf.Timestamp, zones IANA strings, quantities/decimals/money existing common value messages (never floats). Entity-ref arrays and enums follow the data_contract closed vocabulary; source_versions is a bounded list of {source_ref,revision,digest}; field masks select authorized declared fields only. RoleInterval={role,effective_from,effective_to?,owner_ref?}; TypedAnswer={field_id,schema_version,oneof typed primitive/entity/document ref}; all other named record shapes are explicitly defined by this issue data_contract/owning domain. Unknown fields/enum values reject under existing strict wire policy. Principal/tenant/roles are authenticated context; requested scope/representation are selectors checked by server, never authority.
Each proposed query states its exact required/optional fields and returned projection; it has no business mutations. Each proposed command states its own revision owner and output; no blanket WriteEnvelope is added. Mutation success may be committed receipt or typed pending Operation for cross-owner work; response does not mean provider success. Replayed key returns same result; changed payload conflicts. List optional page_size is 1..100 and cursor is signed/bound principal+tenant+company/representation+filters+watermark+expiry. Existing workorder RPC-style HTTP aliases remain, additive /v1 routes below are generated. New SMB endpoint disposition is PHASE_3/4 with correct field classification, never inherited PHASE_1/CONFIDENTIAL_HR.
ErrorDetail mapping: malformed400, unauthenticated401, disclosed-denied403, hidden/absent404, idempotency/state-conflict409, stale revision/precondition412, quota429, unavailable503, deadline504; typed pending202 plus operation resource. Include safe field violations/retry class/correlation and current revision only when authorized. Required security/refusal audit is retained; zero business-success effects on refusal.
Proposed hcmnext.appointment.v1.ServiceVisitService.GetVisitDeliveryStatus -> GET /v1/service-visits:getVisitDeliveryStatus; query.
Request GetVisitDeliveryStatusRequest required: visit_id. Optional: (none). Revision/admission owner: none.
Response GetVisitDeliveryStatusResponse: calendar_operation_state,reminder_state,receipt_refs[],last_checked_at,next_retry_at. Command metadata adds receipt_ref/current_revision only when an owned durable change occurred; pending operation includes operation_ref+state+known component receipts, never a false completion flag. Query projection metadata includes authorized watermark/field dispositions.

Proposed hcmnext.appointment.v1.ServiceVisitService.RetryVisitSynchronization -> POST /v1/service-visits:retryVisitSynchronization; command.
Request RetryVisitSynchronizationRequest required: visit_id,expected_revision,failed_operation_ref,restore_epoch,idempotency_key. Optional: (none). Revision/admission owner: visit revision/restore epoch and original operation identity.
Response RetryVisitSynchronizationResponse: operation_ref,dispatch_state,observation_refs[]. Command metadata adds receipt_ref/current_revision only when an owned durable change occurred; pending operation includes operation_ref+state+known component receipts, never a false completion flag. Query projection metadata includes authorized watermark/field dispositions.

Proposed hcmnext.appointment.v1.ServiceVisitService.ReviewCalendarConflict -> POST /v1/service-visits:reviewCalendarConflict; command.
Request ReviewCalendarConflictRequest required: visit_id,expected_revision,conflict_ref,expected_conflict_revision,disposition:KEEP_LOCAL|GOVERNED_RESCHEDULE|ESCALATE,reason,idempotency_key. Optional: proposed_change_ref. Revision/admission owner: visit/conflict revisions; provider etag bound by referenced conflict.
Response ReviewCalendarConflictResponse: conflict_state,repair_operation_ref,visit_revision. Command metadata adds receipt_ref/current_revision only when an owned durable change occurred; pending operation includes operation_ref+state+known component receipts, never a false completion flag. Query projection metadata includes authorized watermark/field dispositions.
All proposed record projections/commands use the schema field names above plus the data_contract closed enums. Required strings are nonempty and bounded by existing field policy; typed user descriptions/evidence obey the concrete limits in UI/behavior. Validation resolves every EntityRef under current scope before relation expansion. Create commands do not require a nonexistent current record revision; explicitly listed parent/source revision preconditions still apply. Queries and simulations do not use a mutation key unless expressly listed as read-artifact operation. No generic dynamically chosen remote method can be invoked.
behavior: Local commitment is authoritative only when configured; imported external blocks use an explicit calendar source-authority policy and cannot become customer commitments by accident.
Dispatch outcomes distinguish queued/sent/provider-confirmed/failed/unknown; timeout reconciles by external operation key before any retry.
Reminders revalidate current visit revision and contact purpose immediately before dispatch, suppress after cancellation/revocation, and use safe data minimization.
Missed webhooks recover through bounded cursor reconciliation; stale provider updates cannot roll back a later locally confirmed revision.

All writes run through the registered application capability with trusted tenant/actor and current organization/resource/field authority, expected revision, canonical digest and idempotency key. Equal retries replay the original receipt, changed payload rejects; failed validation/auth/revision conflict writes zero domain/business-success rows, business-success journal/outbox entries and provider requests; preserve required sanitized security/refusal audit through its current owner. Reads, search, counts, exports and event payloads enforce the same current scope. Persist domain mutation, append-only journal and outbox in the owning store transaction with tenant RLS and storage-disposition entries.

Reminder claim/dispatch fence includes visit revision, representation/contact policy revision and tenant restore epoch. Claim serializes against reschedule/cancel invalidation: invalidated unclaimed work is suppressed; already-dispatched reminder may have been delivered and is recorded as such, followed by a separately authorized change notice when necessary. Do not claim email recall. Unknown outcomes reconcile under original key+revision+epoch; restored stale queues require owner review, never automatic redelivery.
ui_ux: Exact proposed route contract: /workspace/app/time/schedule?mode=service&visit={id}&tab=delivery; /workspace/app/admin/integrations/calendar-bindings/{id}; /workspace/app/admin/integrations/reconciliation?subject=visit&ref={id}.
Visit detail Delivery section shows Calendar sync and Customer reminder independently with Last checked, next retry and safe error; confirmation stays truthful if notification is delayed.

Admin existing Integrations > calendar binding selects installed provider/account/calendar, source authority and redacted test visit preview. Credential scopes and unqualified adapter state are explicit.
Conflict review presents Local time versus Provider observation with source timestamps; choose governed reschedule, keep local and repair external, or escalate, never edit raw JSON.
Customer notices show only their service/time/site and management link; no worker calendar or private appointment names. All status/error states have text and keyboard-accessible retry.

Use existing internal/humanwork/productui and projectui page/floorplan primitives, GoWebComponents Go SSR + Go/WASM, semantic theme tokens and authorized projections. Qualify 1280x720, 390px and 320px widths, light/dark, en-US/de-DE/ar RTL; translated text, locale dates/numbers, screen-reader labels, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion. Entry is a role-relevant Home pin, My Work item, contextual project link or search result; do not add a permanent global navigation destination.

Each query has bounded loading with status text, genuine empty-state action, typed denied/not-found and retryable error; partial/freshness state is explicit. Mutations preserve drafts on validation/server failure, disable duplicate submit while pending, show server receipt only after durable commit, and refetch on conflict without discarding edits. Offline state allows only explicitly saved draft capture and never claims committed work. Browser Back/Forward and reload preserve authorized route/filter state; focus moves to error summary on failure and returns to initiating control after dialogs.
acceptance: After provider accepts update but response is lost, reconciliation finds one event and does not create a second visit.
Cancel before reminder dispatch produces one suppression receipt and zero customer messages.
Old webhook cannot regress revision 8 to revision 7; conflicting provider edit yields visible review.
